description: Monthly total CI-hours for the pytorch GitHub org, broken down by runner category, from default.workflow_job. CI-hours = completed job wall-clock (started_at -> completed_at), filtered and bucketed by started_at. Staging/canary runners (c-mt-*/c-lf-*/c.*/lf.c.*/canary) are excluded from all panels. Each panel sits in its own collapsed row so its query only runs when the row is expanded.

spec.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(started_at)) AS time, multiIf(runner_group_name = 'GitHub Actions' OR arrayExists(x -> position(x,'ubuntu') > 0 OR (x LIKE 'macos%' AND NOT x LIKE 'macos-m%') OR x LIKE 'windows-%' OR x LIKE 'windows.2022%' OR position(x,'-core-windows') > 0, labels), 'GitHub-hosted', arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'macos-m%', labels), 'MacOS', arrayExists(x -> position(x,'h100') > 0, labels), 'H100', arrayExists(x -> position(x,'b200') > 0 OR position(x,'h200') > 0, labels), 'B200/H200', arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'windows.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.windows.%' OR x LIKE 'mt-windows.%' OR x LIKE 'lf-windows.%', labels), 'Windows', arrayExists(x -> (x LIKE 'linux.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.linux.%' OR x LIKE 'mt-linux.%' OR x LIKE 'lf-linux.%' OR match(x,'^(mt|lf)-(rel-)?l-') OR x LIKE 'lf.l-%' OR match(x,'^(rel-)?l-') OR x LIKE 'arc.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.arc.%' OR x LIKE 'mt.arc.%') AND NOT position(x,'rocm')>0 AND NOT position(x,'xpu')>0 AND NOT position(x,'s390x')>0 AND NOT position(x,'gaudi')>0 AND NOT position(x,'hpu')>0 AND NOT position(x,'google')>0 AND NOT position(x,'tpu')>0, labels), 'Linux autoscaled', 'Partner (donated)') AS category, round(sum(dateDiff('second', started_at, completed_at))/3600.0, 2) AS ci_hours FROM default.workflow_job WHERE started_at >= $__fromTime AND started_at <= $__toTime AND started_at > toDateTime64('2020-01-01', 9) AND status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= started_at AND url LIKE 'https://api.github.com/repos/pytorch/%' AND NOT arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'c-mt-%' OR x LIKE 'c-lf-%' OR x LIKE 'c.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.c.%' OR position(x,'canary')>0, labels) GROUP BY time, category ORDER BY time ASC

spec.description: Monthly CI-hours split into 7 runner categories (priority order, first match wins). GitHub-hosted (GitHub-provided runners) is matched first; H100 and B200/H200 are pulled out of Linux-autoscaled by priority. Partner (donated) = external donated HW. Staging/canary excluded.
spec.title: Monthly CI Hours by Category

spec.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(started_at)) AS time, multiIf(runner_group_name = 'GitHub Actions' OR arrayExists(x -> position(x,'ubuntu') > 0 OR (x LIKE 'macos%' AND NOT x LIKE 'macos-m%') OR x LIKE 'windows-%' OR x LIKE 'windows.2022%' OR position(x,'-core-windows') > 0, labels), '3rd-party', arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'macos-m%', labels), 'Static', arrayExists(x -> position(x,'h100') > 0, labels), 'Static', arrayExists(x -> position(x,'b200') > 0 OR position(x,'h200') > 0, labels), 'Static', arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'windows.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.windows.%' OR x LIKE 'mt-windows.%' OR x LIKE 'lf-windows.%', labels), 'Dynamic', arrayExists(x -> (x LIKE 'linux.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.linux.%' OR x LIKE 'mt-linux.%' OR x LIKE 'lf-linux.%' OR match(x,'^(mt|lf)-(rel-)?l-') OR x LIKE 'lf.l-%' OR match(x,'^(rel-)?l-') OR x LIKE 'arc.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.arc.%' OR x LIKE 'mt.arc.%') AND NOT position(x,'rocm')>0 AND NOT position(x,'xpu')>0 AND NOT position(x,'s390x')>0 AND NOT position(x,'gaudi')>0 AND NOT position(x,'hpu')>0 AND NOT position(x,'google')>0 AND NOT position(x,'tpu')>0, labels), 'Dynamic', '3rd-party') AS bucket, round(sum(dateDiff('second', started_at, completed_at))/3600.0, 2) AS ci_hours FROM default.workflow_job WHERE started_at >= $__fromTime AND started_at <= $__toTime AND started_at > toDateTime64('2020-01-01', 9) AND status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= started_at AND url LIKE 'https://api.github.com/repos/pytorch/%' AND NOT arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'c-mt-%' OR x LIKE 'c-lf-%' OR x LIKE 'c.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.c.%' OR position(x,'canary')>0, labels) GROUP BY time, bucket ORDER BY time ASC

spec.description: Monthly CI-hours rolled up into super-buckets. Static = MacOS + H100 + B200/H200; Dynamic = Windows + Linux autoscaled; 3rd-party = GitHub-hosted + Partner (donated). Staging/canary excluded.
spec.title: Monthly CI Hours by Bucket

spec.rawSql: SELECT category, round(hours, 1) AS ci_hours, round(100.0 * hours / sum(hours) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM (SELECT multiIf(runner_group_name = 'GitHub Actions' OR arrayExists(x -> position(x,'ubuntu') > 0 OR (x LIKE 'macos%' AND NOT x LIKE 'macos-m%') OR x LIKE 'windows-%' OR x LIKE 'windows.2022%' OR position(x,'-core-windows') > 0, labels), 'GitHub-hosted', arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'macos-m%', labels), 'MacOS', arrayExists(x -> position(x,'h100') > 0, labels), 'H100', arrayExists(x -> position(x,'b200') > 0 OR position(x,'h200') > 0, labels), 'B200/H200', arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'windows.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.windows.%' OR x LIKE 'mt-windows.%' OR x LIKE 'lf-windows.%', labels), 'Windows', arrayExists(x -> (x LIKE 'linux.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.linux.%' OR x LIKE 'mt-linux.%' OR x LIKE 'lf-linux.%' OR match(x,'^(mt|lf)-(rel-)?l-') OR x LIKE 'lf.l-%' OR match(x,'^(rel-)?l-') OR x LIKE 'arc.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.arc.%' OR x LIKE 'mt.arc.%') AND NOT position(x,'rocm')>0 AND NOT position(x,'xpu')>0 AND NOT position(x,'s390x')>0 AND NOT position(x,'gaudi')>0 AND NOT position(x,'hpu')>0 AND NOT position(x,'google')>0 AND NOT position(x,'tpu')>0, labels), 'Linux autoscaled', 'Partner (donated)') AS category, sum(dateDiff('second', started_at, completed_at))/3600.0 AS hours FROM default.workflow_job WHERE started_at >= $__fromTime AND started_at <= $__toTime AND started_at > toDateTime64('2020-01-01', 9) AND status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= started_at AND url LIKE 'https://api.github.com/repos/pytorch/%' AND NOT arrayExists(x -> x LIKE 'c-mt-%' OR x LIKE 'c-lf-%' OR x LIKE 'c.%' OR x LIKE 'lf.c.%' OR position(x,'canary')>0, labels) GROUP BY category) ORDER BY hours DESC
